properties.description: Every step that can be added

properties.name: groups
properties.default: [ { id: "triggers", label: "Triggers" }, { id: "ai", label: "AI" }, { id: "tools", label: "Tools" }, { id: "logic", label: "Logic" }, { id: "people", label: "People" }, { id: "output", label: "Output" }, ]
properties.description: The groups, in order; an item whose group isn't here is left out

properties.name: suggestions
properties.description: Steps to suggest when nothing is typed, each with why ("Usually comes after Classify")

properties.name: recent
properties.description: Ids of recently added steps, newest first – shown when nothing is typed

properties.name: query
properties.description: The search text. Changed by the user unless a tc-query-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text in the search field

properties.name: open
properties.description: In popover layout: whether it's showing. Closed by the user (Escape, outside, a pick) unless prevented

properties.name: anchor
properties.description: In popover layout: the element it floats by, and where focus returns when it closes

properties.name: kinds
properties.description: Labels and icons for kinds the page adds, merged over the workflow defaults

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-pick
events.description: A step was chosen ({ id, kind, tool, item }: StepPick); cancelable – prevented, a popover stays open

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The search text changed ({ query }: StepPickerQueryChange); cancelable – prevented, `query` stays as it was

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The popover opened or closed ({ open }: StepPickerOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

functions.name: defaultStepItems
functions.description: A starting catalogue – replace it with your own steps and tools

props.name: query
props.description: The search text – controlled when given

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The search text on mount when `query` isn't controlled

props.name: open
props.description: In popover layout: whether it's showing – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it shows on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: anchor
props.description: In popover layout: the element it floats by – a ref's current element

props.name: onPick
props.type: (kind: string, item: StepPickerItem, tool?: string) => void | boolean
props.description: A step was chosen; return false to keep a popover open

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
